direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; preserve fit without shrinking interactive targets below 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for the stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo block above the inspector; keep only the header logo here and reserve the second placement for the opening story.
Enlarge the 120 versus 80 tracks and align their ends so DOES NOT MATCH reads as one measured gap at stage scale.
Raise silverDim body text on RECEIVING, CELL-MILL-1 and CELL-MILL-2 labels to full contrast and add a focus ring to each focusable SVG node.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT, including nonce and identity status, from INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct panels, headings and status lines; never share one control state.
Add explicit Pre-flight: not run / Route: Sample offline text beside the selector so offline is understood before Run Sample investigation.
Make the primary action reachable after the selector in tab order and announce its result only through aria-live polite.
Keep selecting a recovery option as the trigger that opens this typed consent form; retain exact-phrase count 0/27 and keep Accept disabled until it matches.
Enlarge the selected-path marker and add pattern plus text so selection does not rely on neon outline alone.
Compress option card vertical padding by 4px to give the consent input a clear focus ring without inspector crowding at 1366x768.
Keep 0 tracked and PROPOSED UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL adjacent to every proposal; do not add tracking controls before Approve Britt's proposal is chosen.
Show all 3 proposed tasks without requiring scroll, or add a visible 3 of 3 count and a larger internal scroll target.
Strengthen the MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts route label against the neon trace with a dark text plate for legibility.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview visually distinct from applied state: dashed silver preview only, and reserve red cross-hatch for after Apply second shock.
Place Will invalidate acceptance directly beside the machine selector and repeat it in the DecisionBar status centre.
Add focus ring and aria-describedby to the machine selector linking it to the invalidation consequence.
Preserve red exclusively on CELL-MILL-2 with OFFLINE-STOPPED text and cross-hatch; ensure no feasible route is drawn through it and 3 to 2 feasible paths is stated once.
Again separate pre-flight nonce and identity health from the investigation task; label the lower panel Choose a route, then Investigate as its own evidence action.
Enlarge CONSTRAINED capacity changed text on the Split option and pair it with an x marker matching the legend.
Keep the typed consent form tied to the selected revised option, with Accept revised decision disabled until the exact phrase matches and prior acceptance invalidated shown in the DecisionBar.
Give the constrained Split card a clear unavailable pattern and text reason, not only dimming, so it cannot be mistaken for selectable.
Align 83h, 35h and cost columns on one tabular baseline across all three option cards.
Keep blocked prior tasks and the approved recovery plan visible together while replacement tasks stay PROPOSED UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL; label each group separately.
Reduce inspector double scrolling: use one scroll region with sticky Prior tracked work and Revised proposal headings.
Add counts 3 blocked prior and 3 proposed replacement in the inspector title area so coexistence is scannable without reading full cards.
Sequence Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet and Retain independent checkpoint as numbered locked steps; disable step 3 until step 2 is complete and state that dependency in text.
Keep passphrase guidance 16-160 chars, three word or character types directly under the field and move it into aria-describedby.
Enlarge the Before-After metrics 70, 35h and 48h into one aligned proof strip and keep Verify ledger as the single primary in the DecisionBar until it completes.
Confirm this closing view contains no additional logo beyond the header placement; retain the opening story as the only other placement in the full flow.
Make PACKET SEALED, 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained the sole completion status, with no new primary action competing in the DecisionBar.
Add Complete current ledger check marks with text labels to steps 1-3 so completion does not rely on neon borders alone.
